_comment: The recorded pinned-build baseline arm for the plan.publish empty-slot invariant. Produced via WF-345's pinned-build install option: the pre-slot plan build installed as the run source. Carries the pinned build's fingerprint and the run fingerprints of the baseline set. CANNED per item.md's disclosure — Docker + CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN are unavailable in this environment; the run bytes are shaped exactly like the WF-345 runner's output tree, and runner/run-skill.sh regenerates them from the real pinned build when a container and token are available.
